post.description: Counts the input tokens of a Messages request (#72). Authorized like POST /v1/messages: the workspace and key come from the validated inference key, and the model must be one the key may use now and must serve the messages protocol. Anthropic routes ask Anthropic's counting endpoint with the connection's own credential; every other route returns the gateway estimate. The route is the first one routing would choose; a count never fails over and is not an attempt. Each gateway process bounds counts by key per minute, by provider connection credential per minute (provider-backed counts only) and by its own concurrency pool, separate from generation, of which one key may hold at most 2 counts at once (429 beyond any of them; a count refused for concurrency does not spend the key's minute). A count consults no budget or rate limit and does not consume the key's request-rate allowance. The body cap is 2097152 bytes. A body with inline images may exceed it only when it declares its Content-Length, is at most GATEWAY_MAX_BODY_BYTES_IMAGE_INPUT (default 20971520 bytes), fits this replica's image input buffer (GATEWAY_IMAGE_INPUT_BUFFER_BYTES), keeps arriving (no pause of more than 10 s, at least 128 KiB/s on average from its start after a 128 KiB allowance, at most 180 s in all) and has at most 2097152 bytes outside its images' base64. Authentication and the length checks run before any body byte is read. Every refusal is an Anthropic-shaped JSON error: 413 request_too_large, 408 invalid_request_error, 503 overloaded_error with Retry-After.
